text:
```yaml
name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  check-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for potential duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          label: potential-duplicate
          comment: "We found some existing issues that may be similar to this one:\n\n{potential_duplicates}\n\nPlease check if your issue is already reported. If it is, please consider adding a comment to the existing issue instead of creating a new one."
          threshold: 0.9
```
